runs.text: Thirty seven signatures. And one promise most people never <<ˈ|r|ɛ|d>>. May fourteen, one thousand nine hundred and forty eight. Tel Aviv. David Ben Gurion reads Israel's Declaration of Independence. It declares a Jewish state, in the Land of Israel. Then this: complete equality of social and political rights, irrespective of religion, race or sex. It calls on the Arab inhabitants to help build the state, as full and equal citizens. And it offers peace to every neighbouring state. The signers ran from religious leaders to a communist. The next day, five Arab armies invaded. Israel hasn't always lived up to it. Until nineteen sixty six, Arab citizens lived under a military government. Today, Arab citizens sit in the <<k|ə|ˈ|n|ɛ|s|ɪ|t>> and on the Supreme Court. Has Israel kept the promise? Tell me below. One document. Signed by
